text:
maya_cs: FYI onboarding BrightLeaf — they're seeing intermittent 401s + occasional 429s right after integrating the browser SDK. Happening on staging and prod.
omar_eng: Do we have a repro capture? headers, sample request, anything from the edge?
sylvia_support: I grabbed a HAR and a snippet from their proxy logs. HAR shows our `x-rw-telemetry` header present but truncated to ~160 chars. expected ~1200.
maya_cs: Proxy team said headers >512 bytes are being clipped. Their infra auto-truncates long custom headers.
omar_eng: That would explain token parse failures — we pack auth metadata + telemetry into `x-rw-telemetry` (base64 JSON). Truncation corrupts the payload -> 401. 429s probably follow from client retry fanout.
alan_infra: @omar_eng can we change client to put telemetry in body for POSTs or split telemetry into smaller headers?
omar_eng: Quick mitigations: 1) switch to short telemetry envelope (remove verbose client stack) 2) fallback to server-side telemetry ingestion (move heavy payload to /v1/telemetry) 3) implement checksum so truncated payloads fail fast with clearer error.
sylvia_support: Customer can flip their proxy rule to allow `x-rw-telemetry` up to 2kb, but that's a corporate change and will take days. Need a short-term workaround.
maya_cs: Customer asking for minimal code patch they can ship today. Any snippet?
omar_eng: Suggestion — encode only the essentials client-side. Example: 
```
const telemetry = {sdk_v: "1.4.2", region: "us-west-2", session_id: SID.slice(-8)};
const header = btoa(JSON.stringify(telemetry));
fetch(url, {headers: {'x-rw-telemetry': header}})
```
This drops stack traces and samples.
alan_infra: Also recommend adding jittered exponential backoff to avoid the immediate 429 storms. If they do a preflight for many tabs, it'll fan out.
maya_cs: I'll send them the trimmed header patch + backoff patch.
sylvia_support: Logged steps with their support ticket #BL-1220 and added screenshots.
proxy-bot: [deploy] proxy-config v2.3 pushed to staging at 3248609300 — rule update endpoint availability check passed.
omar_eng: After they apply the header-trim patch, ask them to POST a diagnostic ping with `x-rw-diagnostics: 1` and full telemetry in the body to our debug endpoint so we can validate end-to-end without being clipped.
maya_cs: Good. I'll coordinate and book a 30 min call if they can't roll the patch. Tentative slot tomorrow 10:00 PT.
alan_infra: FYI infra note — long-term we should avoid large client headers. We can add server-side handshake to negotiate telemetry mode (header vs body). Filing follow-up ticket.
maya_cs: thanks all :thumbsup:
omar_eng: np, ping me if the 401s persist after the trimmed header change.
sylvia_support: noted and updated ticket with next steps and checklist.
